title: Qt: Lua Debugger: Support modal dialogs when paused
description:
Refactor pause freeze logic into isPauseAllowedWindow() helper to properly
handle modal dialogs and window modality. Rename isOwnedByDebugger() to
isAllowedDuringPause() for clarity and delegate to the new helper.

This allows users to interact with modal windows while the debugger is
paused, improving the debugging experience.

AI-Assisted: yes
